scopeNotes: New text needs independent review; earlier hashes do not certify it.
Map endpoints are not historical founding or extinction dates.

The two imported records cover1920–1938 and1960–present. They are treated as regional map coverage because both begin during colonial Bechuanaland, before the Republic of Botswana became independent on30September1966. No imported polygons or historical-basemap files are edited. Geometry identity is checked, exact boundaries remain uncertified.

Neil Parsons’s1999 history is used for colonial chronology and broad cultural plurality; its separate education page is used for the Swaneng experiment. The combined public text derived from these two pages is kept within200words including source labels and notes. Obsolete present-tense political and economic descriptions, and older archaeological ethnic identifications, are not adopted. The1885–1966 protectorate interval was cross-checked against the UK National Archives research guide.

The parliament source is used only for its account of1966, not as authority for current constituency numbers, office holders or every constitutional amendment. The Attorney General source was read in full indexed text for its office-location history. The1965 move is not presented as a single date for every department’s relocation.

The Kutlwano article is a reprint of a contemporary1966 announcement by JNormanEngland. Its future tense is retained as evidence for planned bonfires and flag ceremonies, not confirmation that every event occurred. The current magazine sidebar is unrelated and not used.

The UNESCO pottery description concerns Bakgatla ba Kgafela makers in Kgatleng, recorded in the2012 inscription. Its daughters/granddaughters account is locally scoped; no universal gender rule or ancestral medical efficacy is asserted. These are documented living practices, not proof of an unchanged prehistoric tradition.

Thitaku Kushanya’s childhood story was read in the indexed first-person maker profile. The direct page returned a fetch error. The remembered ages and first-sale amount are attributed to her; no birth year or modern price is inferred. Personal contact details are excluded. The source’s ambiguous reference to a closed institution is not repeated.

DeMotts2017 was accessed through publisher indexed text and an18-page open PDF copy at https://pdfs.semanticscholar.org/38d1/68505b802d1324ba568b3474eb5edff37a1b.pdf . Introduction and selected methods/findings on pages369 and372–379 were read.2013 interviews with86women do not represent all Botswana households. Pattern captions and tools in Figure2 are specific evidence. The original work and all copies share one source-word budget; no PDF access is claimed for the blocked publisher route.

Kavora Basketry’s own home-page account supplies its name and intergenerational livelihood aims. It is a first-party group description, not independent verification of current membership, income or an ancient foundation date.

The University Foundation’s indexed opening account establishes the1976 appeal. The16-page January2023 newsletter was downloaded and page16 read for donations and statue. Its abbreviated early institutional history is not adopted;1964/1966 predecessor institutions and independence in1982 must not be conflated with the1976 campaign. No present-day enrolment or donor total is asserted.

Gabonthone2024 is used from the repository abstract only. The full thesis was not accessed. The title’s1968–2023 scope is not automatically converted into a museum opening date, and no specific museum objects are fabricated.

The Tsodilo World Heritage statement distinguishes a discontinuous100,000-year archaeological record from uncertain painting dates. The page does not claim paintings are100,000years old, that one people made all images, or that a single interpretation explains them. Living sacred associations are attributed to named communities.

New prose is author-checked and pending independent historical-depth review. Structural checks and source links do not certify exhaustive cultural coverage, present-day legal details or exact polygon boundaries. No unsupported medicine, toilet or household practice is invented to fill a topic.

proposedOverrides.summary: Botswana became an independent republic on 30 September 1966, after British rule as the Bechuanaland Protectorate. Earlier map entries cover the same territory before independence; their dates do not mark the birth or disappearance of its communities.

sharedAssociations.basis: Both imported Botswana labels refer geographically to the territory of modern Botswana. The shared regional history explicitly separates colonial Bechuanaland from the independent republic of1966.
